transcript.content: Hello, welcome in—I'm Dr. [Name]. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Well, what brought me in is... I keep leaving my station at work, or I'll just pop up during meetings when I'm supposed to stay put. My supervisor actually said it's becoming a safety problem, because I just take off before I even think about it. So, that's why I'm here.
Can you tell me if you've experienced this kind of restlessness, impulsivity, or trouble staying seated since you were a child, or is this something that started more recently as an adult?

It's been since I was a kid. Even back in elementary school, I was the kid who just couldn't stay in my seat. I'd talk over the teacher a lot, and... I got notes sent home all the time for blurting things out or just wandering around the room. So yeah, it's definitely not a new thing for me.
Do you also find it hard to stay focused on tasks, follow through on details, or that you often lose track of things or get easily distracted, both now and back when you were a kid?

No, not really. I don't think I have a problem with losing things or forgetting details. It's not really that I get distracted... it's just that I can't stay put. Like, when I'm working on the line, I know exactly what I'm doing and I can focus on the task fine. I just physically end up walking away from my station. So yeah, I wouldn't say I lose track of stuff or have trouble focusing, even back when I was a kid. It was always just the moving around and talking too much.
Do you often find yourself interrupting or blurting out answers before others finish speaking, or having trouble waiting your turn in conversations or lines?

Yeah, I do that a lot. I cut in on people without really meaning to. Like... I'll just jump right into my coworkers' conversations, or if the shift lead is asking something, I'll answer before they're even done talking. I just kind of blurt it out. And then everybody gets irritated with me, so... yeah, waiting my turn to speak is definitely a problem for me.
Do you notice this same restlessness and impulsive blurting or interrupting happening in other areas of your life too, like at home or in social situations, not just at work?

Yeah, it's pretty much everywhere. At home, I'm always pacing around the apartment or tapping my feet when I'm trying to watch TV. And with my friends... I mean, I try not to, but I'm always talking over them or finishing their sentences. It's just hard for me to hold back what I want to say, so it definitely happens when I'm hanging out with them, too.

Have you ever had distinct periods lasting several days where you felt unusually elevated, euphoric, or irritable, needed much less sleep than usual, and had racing thoughts, separate from how you feel most of the time?

No, I can't say I've ever had anything like that. I mean, I'm pretty much always energetic and moving around, but it's just my normal. It's not like a phase for a few days where I'm suddenly way more hyper or need less sleep. My sleep is pretty regular, honestly. And my thoughts don't really race like that, I just... I just have a hard time keeping my body still and keeping quiet. But no weird phases of feeling super high or irritable like you're describing.
